_note: Written BEFORE any run of this rule (no simulation, no signal, no reproduction check had been run). IN SAMPLE ONLY: every frame is read with ts < 2022-01-01; nothing dated 2022 or later is read.
frozen_name: IDXRS_1000: US index relative-strength pair, 10:00 to 15:55 New York
frozen_rule:
CLOCK AND DAYS: New York (DST-aware), NYSE full sessions; early closes skipped. Mid = (bid+ask)/2 of M1 bars.

SIGNAL at 10:00:
- For us100, us500 and us30: r_i = ln(mid close of the 09:59 bar / mid open of the 09:30 bar).
- RAW returns, as in r2/tracks/leadlag/desc_rs.py. The team's z-ranking is not used: it adds a free choice, and it adds us500-against-us30 days, whose per-leg results were negative.
- S = argmax r, W = argmin r, D = r_S - r_W.
- Trade only if D >= the 75th percentile of D over the previous 60 sessions (at least 40 values).

HEDGE: h = sd_S / sd_W, where sd = standard deviation of each index's 10:00->15:55 log return over the previous 60 sessions.

ENTRY at the open of the 10:00 M1 bar: market BUY S (notional N) and market SELL W (notional h x N) in the same minute. If one leg fails, close the other at once.

PAIR MARK: pi = ln(P_S/P_S,fill) - h x ln(P_W/P_W,fill), at exit-side prices.

STOP: close both legs at market when pi <= -1.5 x sd_pi. sd_pi = sd over the previous 60 sessions of the hedged 10:00->15:55 mid return of the pair the same ranking picked each day, traded or not.

EXIT: both legs at the open of the 15:55 bar. One pair a day; every signal is taken.

SIZING: 1 R = 1.5 x sd_pi x N; R = net pi / (1.5 x sd_pi). On the account, a signal whose two legs cannot both be placed at the broker's minimum lot within 1.5 % risk is skipped (Addendum E).
frozen_test_plan:
12 configurations, declared before any run. The verdict is read on (1) only.

(1) Main, as in 'rule'.

Neighbours:
(2) ranking and entry at 09:55
(3) ranking and entry at 10:15
(4) threshold Q67
(5) threshold Q80
(6) look-back windows of 40 sessions
(7) look-back windows of 80 sessions
(8) pair stop 1.25 sd_pi
(9) pair stop 1.75 sd_pi
(10) exit 15:59, the descriptive's horizon

Stress: (11) main with spread and slippage x1.5.

Null: (12) 200 replays of the main's pairs at 10:00 on randomly drawn sessions, with the same legs, sides, stop (in sd_pi units) and holding time. The main must sit at or above the 97.5th percentile.

COST: FP frames (spreads 0.37 / 0.54 / 0.35 bp, r2/fp_costs.json); market slippage 0.2 bp per side per leg; 0.5 bp per leg on stop exits; no swap. About 1.5-1.7 bp per pair round trip.

PASS = PROTOCOL_V3 s.4 single-sleeve bars on the pair's R: n >= 250; PF >= 1.12; t >= 2.5; >= 60 % of years positive; PF >= 1.04 at x1.5; neighbours' median PF >= 1.06; every-signal expectancy > 0; null >= 97.5th percentile. Two more conditions, declared now:
- weekly R correlation with ocm4 + noise30 at most 0.30 over 2014-2021 (otherwise it counts inside the us100 cluster and is not breadth);
- at least 2 of the 3 pair types (us100/us500, us100/us30, us500/us30) with positive expectancy.

REPRODUCTION CHECK before the run (not a trial): the two-leg simulator, with stops off, no costs and the in-sample quantile, must reproduce the 10:00 'open' row of desc_rs.py (+2.69 / +8.06 bp).

REPORTED, NOT JUDGED: gross bp per pair; results by pair type and by side of us100; a 1,000 EUR run in which us30 pairs are skipped below about 4,000 EUR.

Expected in-sample n about 480. The single VAL look (about 240 pairs) uses the PROTOCOL_V3 s.4 VAL bars.
frozen_instruments: us100, us500, us30: FP cash CFDs, frames lab/data/fp/{us100,us500,us30}_m1.parquet (us30 starts 2013-09-30). One pair a day.

param_legend.entry_min: New York minute of the entry bar = ranking time (rank on the bar before)
param_legend.exit_min: New York minute of the exit bar
param_legend.minv: minimum finite values in a window

costs.spread: inside the FP frames (lab/data/fp, r2/fp_costs.json: 0.37 / 0.54 / 0.35 bp for us100 / us500 / us30 at the reference price, Dukascopy intraday shape)

readings_of_open_details.R1_period_and_sessions: In sample only: every frame is read with the parquet filter ts < 2022-01-01. Sessions = NYSE full sessions from the rule-based calendar already used by noise30/ocm4 (r2/tracks/idx_us/idxus_lib.us_holidays, imported read-only): weekdays that are neither a full closure nor a 13:00 early close. Early-close days are not sessions at all (not traded and not counted in any look-back window). The three frames are needed for a ranking, so the first possible session is the first one on which us30 has data (2013-09-30); after the warm-up the first trade falls in 2014.
readings_of_open_details.R2_bars: 'the 09:30 bar' / 'the 09:59 bar' / 'the 10:00 bar' / 'the 15:55 bar' = the M1 bar that STARTS at that New York minute (bars are labelled by their start). A day has a ranking only if the 09:30 bar and the (T-1) bar exist for all three indices; otherwise D, the returns and the pair return of that day are missing (no trade, and the day gives no value to the look-back windows). Ties for the maximum or the minimum of r: no ranking that day.
readings_of_open_details.R3_threshold: Q = the q-quantile (numpy/pandas linear interpolation) of D over the finite values among the previous `win` sessions (the current day excluded), at least `minv` values; trade if D >= Q.
readings_of_open_details.R4_hedge_and_windows: sd_i = sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of index i's log return from the mid OPEN of the entry bar to the mid OPEN of the exit bar (10:00 -> 15:55 in the main; each neighbour uses its own entry / exit clock) over the finite values among the previous `win` sessions, at least `minv` values (the rule states 'at least 40 values' for the quantile only; the same minimum is applied to every window); a day's return is missing if either bar is missing. h = sd_S / sd_W with today's S and W. A day trades only if D >= Q and h and sd_pi are defined (and R11 holds).
readings_of_open_details.R5_sd_pi: pi_j (mid) of each previous session j = ret_S(j) - h_j * ret_W(j), with day j's own ranking S_j / W_j and day j's own h_j (from day j's own trailing windows), computed for every session that has a ranking, traded or not. sd_pi = sample sd (ddof=1) of pi over the finite values among the previous `win` sessions, at least `minv` values.
readings_of_open_details.R6_min_values_of_other_windows: The rule states 'at least 40 values' for 60-session windows; the 40- and 80-session neighbours keep the same two-thirds share: at least 27 and 54 values. All three windows (quantile, sd for h, sd_pi) take the neighbour's length.
readings_of_open_details.R7_entry: Both legs need an M1 bar starting exactly at T; otherwise the signal is not entered ('if one leg fails'). Fills: BUY S at the ask open x (1 + 0.2 bp), SELL W at the bid open x (1 - 0.2 bp), same minute, notionals N and h x N.
readings_of_open_details.R8_stop_monitoring: Hard rule 3 (decisions on closed bars, execution at the next open): on the close of every M1 bar from the entry bar to the bar before the exit bar, pi is marked at exit-side closes (S at its bid close, W at its ask close; the last known close of a leg that has no bar in that minute). If pi <= -k x sd_pi, both legs are closed at the open of the next bar (for each leg its first bar at or after the next minute): S at bid x (1 - 0.5 bp), W at ask x (1 + 0.5 bp). A stop decided on the close of the last bar before the exit bar is executed at the exit bar's open and pays the stop slippage. No intrabar trigger is assumed (an M1 frame cannot order the two legs' extremes).
readings_of_open_details.R9_time_exit: Both legs at the open of the first bar at or after the exit minute (15:55 in the main): S at bid x (1 - 0.2 bp), W at ask x (1 + 0.2 bp). No position crosses the 17:00 New York rollover, so no swap.
readings_of_open_details.R10_R_unit: net pi = ln(P_S,exit / P_S,fill) - h x ln(P_W,exit / P_W,fill) at the actual fill prices (spread and slippage inside them), as the rule writes it; R = net pi / (k x sd_pi), k = the stop multiple (1.5 in the main; 1.25 / 1.75 in neighbours 8 / 9, i.e. R per unit of the initial pair risk as goldlab defines R; a constant k does not change PF or t). The money result with simple returns (N x (P_S,exit/P_S,fill - 1) - hN x (P_W,exit/P_W,fill - 1)) is reported beside it, not judged.
readings_of_open_details.R11_stop_floor: Hard rule 4: the pair is refused if k x sd_pi < 3 x (spread_S + h x spread_W), spreads = quoted (ask - bid) / mid at the open of the entry bar, on the frame of the run (widened in the stress run).
readings_of_open_details.R12_stress: Configuration 11: each leg's frame is widened with goldlab.sim.apply_spread_mult(frame, 1.5) (the lab's transform, mid unchanged, so the signals are unchanged) and both slippages x 1.5 (0.3 bp market, 0.75 bp stop).
readings_of_open_details.R13_every_signal: The rule takes every signal (one pair a day, intraday, no overlap possible): the every-signal run is the main run.
readings_of_open_details.R14_null: Configuration 12: each of the main's filled pairs is replayed with the same legs and sides (BUY S, SELL W), the same hedge ratio h, the same stop level -1.5 x sd_pi and R unit 1.5 x sd_pi of the original trade (the stop kept in sd_pi units of that trade, as the lab's null keeps a trade's own stop distance), entry at the open of the 10:00 bar and time exit at 15:55 (the main's holding time), FP costs, same fill and stop rules, on a session drawn uniformly with replacement among all in-sample full sessions (2013-09-30 to 2021-12-31) on which both legs have a 10:00 bar. 200 replays (numpy default_rng(0)); statistic = mean R; percentile = share of replays whose mean R is below the main's; pass >= 97.5. The replays are not re-filtered (no threshold, no stop floor): they replay the main's filled pairs.
readings_of_open_details.R15_weekly_correlation: Weekly sums of R booked at the exit week (pandas weekly periods W-SUN of the UTC exit time, as goldlab.metrics), every calendar week from the week of 2014-01-01 to the week of 2021-12-31 counted (weeks without a trade = 0), Pearson correlation. ocm4 and noise30 = their official trades (results/r2/recalc/trades, read with the filter entry_time < 2022-01-01; any trade exiting in 2022 dropped). The condition 'at most 0.30' is read as |rho| <= 0.30 (stricter than rho <= 0.30).
readings_of_open_details.R16_pair_types: Expectancy of a pair type (us100/us500, us100/us30, us500/us30, whichever side is long) = mean R of the main's trades of that type; a type without trades counts as not positive.
readings_of_open_details.R17_years: Years positive = calendar years of entry with at least one trade whose summed R > 0; bar >= 60 %.
readings_of_open_details.R18_exit_1559: Neighbour 10 'exit 15:59' = both legs at the open of the 15:59 bar (the rule's convention: exits at bar opens); its windows use the 10:00 -> 15:59 returns.
readings_of_open_details.R19_neighbour_median: Neighbours = configurations 2-10 (nine); their median PF must be >= 1.06.
readings_of_open_details.R20_reproduction_check: Not a trial: the same grid and two-leg code with h = 1, no stop, no cost, entry at the mid open of the 10:00 bar, exit at the mid close of the 15:59 bar, on desc_rs.py's own sample (weekdays 2014-2021 with the 09:30 and 10:00 opens present and closes forward-filled up to 3 minutes, as its grid does), dispersion cuts at the whole-sample quantiles; must give +2.69 bp (all days) and +8.06 bp (top quartile).
readings_of_open_details.R21_account_run_reported_only: 1,000 EUR account, 1 % of the current balance per pair, compounding; position sizes at TODAY's price level (r2/fp_costs.json spread_ref_price: us100 27000, us500 7377, us30 51286; Addendum E convention), USD -> EUR 0.89 (r2/tracks/stake/account.py), lot 1 index unit, minimum lot and step 0.1. N = budget / (1.5 x sd_pi); lots rounded down; a leg below 0.1 lot is raised to 0.1 if the pair's risk at those lots (1.5 x sd_pi x max(N_S, N_W / h)) is within 1.5 % of the balance, else the signal is skipped; pairs with us30 are skipped while the balance is below 4,000 EUR; the money result uses each leg's own simple return and lots.
readings_of_open_details.R22_reported_not_judged: Gross bp per pair (a separate run on mid prices, no slippage), cost per pair, results by pair type and by side of us100, the 1,000 EUR run, the correlation with the sum of the ten and with each cluster, and the money result.

pass_criteria_main.extra_corr_ocm4_noise30<=0.30: |weekly R correlation with ocm4 + noise30| <= 0.30 over 2014-2021 (R15)
pass_criteria_main.extra_pair_types>=2: at least 2 of the 3 pair types with positive expectancy (R16)
